title: Quick access defaults per domain (data/quick-access.json)
description: The one source for the quick access rules (widgets, controls, App Intents) of hub, Admin UI and apps. Lookup like tile-capabilities: the first entry of domains[] whose domains list contains the entity domain, else the entry with "_other". Effective level of an entity for a device = min(admin level or default, domain max, device max quick_access_max); critical entities start at status (default capped) and need critical_ack for control. Only entities in the device's read scope (areas/tags, is_visible) count. Generated as a constant for every language (codegen ContractData).

version.description: Data version, raised with every change of this file.

max.description: Highest level the admin may choose (off = fixed off).

critical.description: Every entity of the domain is critical: default capped at status, control only with critical_ack, widgets never switch it in the unsafe direction, controls require an unlocked device.

critical_device_classes.description: Entities with one of these device_class values are critical (e.g. cover garage/gate/door), even if critical is false.

safe_direction.description: The direction a widget or control may switch directly (lock = lock.lock, arm = alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_* without code_arm_required). The other direction (unlock, disarm) always opens the app with its confirmation. null = no direction rule.
